elements.label: Trace flame graph UI (zoomed toward the hovered rails.charge_payment span)
Span hover tooltip (rides the zoom, grows from small to legible)

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: 440 ms before the burst; same periodic percussion as the rest of the bed.

pattern.description: The camera pushes in about 1.4x on the trace flame graph, centring the hovered span and its tooltip while the error log panel below drops out of frame; the 'to a single transaction' caption stays fixed on top.
pattern.why_premium: The zoom matches the line 'to a single transaction', narrowing from the full trace to one span so the viewer's eye goes straight to the detail, and the caption stays legible because it is not scaled.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.ui-layer', {scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0}, {scale: 1.42, x: '-2%', y: '-3%', transformOrigin: '45% 25%', duration: 0.55, ease: 'expo.out'}); caption on a separate unscaled layer.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 28, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); UI layer transform: scale(interpolate(p,[0,1],[1,1.42])) with transformOrigin '45% 25%'; caption rendered outside the scaled container.

notes: Energy decays long after the peak, which suggests a strong ease-out tail; code timing will confirm. The caption is static, so it is not listed.
